summary.text: Linda T. Sánchez was first elected to the U.S. House in 2002; she represents California's 38th Congressional District and is on the November 3, 2026 ballot in California's 41st District.

paragraphs.text: She was born in Orange, California, in 1969, and earned a bachelor's degree in Spanish literature from UC Berkeley and a J.D. from UCLA in 1995.
Before Congress she worked as a labor and employment attorney and as executive secretary and treasurer of the Orange County AFL-CIO.
